_comment: x_ssa_fed_compliance control map (Vol VII Book 05). Finding-class -> (control, task type, approval, actuation, KSI, slot) for the five-step compliance loop. Projection of aan-compliance-spine.yml — the union of the Book 02 (M365), Book 03 (Azure) and Book 04 (attestation) closures the app operates — CI-validated against it by validate_day2_control_maps.py (multi-book entry). Actuation is ALWAYS platform-native: ServiceNow raises, routes, evidences; it never writes to the estate. Scope: FedRAMP Moderate + GCC Moderate.

m365.baseline.drift.title: M365 SCuBA / secure-baseline drift
m365.baseline.drift.note: SCuBA / secure-baseline drift on the M365 surface raised as a tracked Change with owner and SLA; remediation actuates in the platform (Vol VII Book 02). The same finding class covers Azure Policy / Defender recommendations (Book 03) — one CM-6 binding, two ingest sources.

m365.account.exception.title: Entra account / Conditional-Access exception work
m365.account.exception.note: JML and Conditional-Access exception requests raised, approved and access-reviewed as tasks over the Entra estate (Vol VII Book 02). Exceptions carry mandatory expiry — the Book 02 pattern the day-2 app reuses.

azure.patch.remediation.title: Azure patch / flaw-remediation task
azure.patch.remediation.note: Azure Update Manager patch results reconciled into Change/Incident with SLA-class keyed to KEV/exposure (Vol VII Book 03); actuation is Update Manager's, not ServiceNow's.

azure.vuln.finding.title: Defender / MDVM vulnerability finding
azure.vuln.finding.note: Defender for Cloud / MDVM findings flow to Vulnerability Response as prioritized remediation tasks (Vol VII Book 03).

attest.control.test.title: Control-test / assessment task
attest.control.test.note: IRM/GRC control tests and evidence tasks producing assessed control state for the authorization package (Vol VII Book 04).

attest.poam.item.title: POA&M item lifecycle
attest.poam.item.note: POA&M items tracked as IRM issues with owner, milestone and closure evidence (Vol VII Book 04). A failed ComplianceGate re-test opens one automatically.

attest.conmon.rollup.title: ConMon posture roll-up + re-test evidence
attest.conmon.rollup.note: ComplianceGate's closure-by-observation verdicts and the rolled-up posture emitted as OSCAL/KSI evidence into the ConMon package (Vol VII Books 02 and 04). This is the item every other finding class terminates in.
